name: VAULTDIVE: Full-Body Immersion Pod Arcade
description: A chain of cramped but technically sophisticated immersion pod arcades originally seeded in Tier 2 transit hubs, VAULTDIVE offers full-body haptic submersion in competitive multiplayer environments ranging from pre-Collapse cityscapes to alien terraforming scenarios. Each pod isolates the user in a gel-suspension cradle with full BCI handshake, allowing genuine proprioceptive feedback — you feel the fall, the impact, the cold. The chain's reputation for hardware that's one firmware update behind corporate competitors keeps prices accessible and the clientele loyal.
story_hooks: A teenage runner from the Gray Zone discovers she has an inexplicable combat-reflex edge in VAULTDIVE ladders — someone has been feeding her live tactical data through a hidden BCI overlay she didn't consent to
Two estranged siblings meet anonymously inside a VAULTDIVE shared scenario, neither knowing the other is there, and begin rebuilding a relationship through fictional avatars
A VAULTDIVE technician finds that one pod's log files contain recordings of sessions that never officially happened — someone has been using the hardware for something other than gaming
